title: TD-Gammon — AAAI Fall Symposium Publication Milestone
summary: Gerald Tesauro published a TD-Gammon paper for AAAI-FS 1993 on 22 October 1993. IBM Research describes TD-Gammon as a neural network that learned to play backgammon through self-play using the TD(lambda) reinforcement-learning algorithm and reports that a version with hand-crafted input features was estimated to play at a strong master level.
significance: A primary-institutional publication milestone documenting an early reinforcement-learning system that learned a complex game through self-play. The record is limited to the 1993 publication and claims stated by IBM Research rather than treating the publication date as the system's creation date.

verification.note: IBM Research directly records the paper title, author, publication venue, 22 October 1993 date, and abstract describing TD-Gammon's self-play training using TD(lambda) and its reported playing strength. This candidate treats 22 October 1993 only as the publication milestone; it does not infer the system's creation date, development geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.

sources.title: TD-Gammon, A Self-Teaching Backgammon Program, Achieves Master-Level Play

candidateMeta.admissionReason: IBM Research directly supports the 22 October 1993 publication milestone and the technical claims retained here. Publication chronology remains separate from system-origin, priority, ancestry, influence, and causality claims.
